name: صفحة جامع البطاقات — M7mod
title: Design System: صفحة جامع البطاقات (M7mod)
signature_move: Staggered card cascade: 8 fixed-scale pockets (aspect 1/1.14, which holds pocket size while the art is hidden) on one shared 4x2 baseline. Each pocket first holds a neutral-sleeve question-mark flicker (rarity sleeve held at the hairline color, no rarity chroma while the card is unknown) with the ? pulsing (questionPulse .7s: opacity .35 to .8, scale 1 to 1.12); at the end of its 45ms x 8 stagger window the pocket plays cardReveal (.34s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), scale .9 to 1.02 overshoot to 1, opacity .35 to 1), a one-shot paper inkFlash (radial #f5f1e6 at 22% alpha, .55s), and stamps on the rarity sleeve. The elixir meter (fill width driven by --avg) settles exactly when the average lands. Symmetric about the center axis.

display.purpose: Arabic poster face from the subject's world: gaming posters and YouTube thumbnails. h1, section titles, stat values, the generate button, 'مستبعدة' overlay.

ui.purpose: Geometric workhorse for all Arabic UI text; 400 base, 500 labels and hints.

numeral.purpose: Tabular figures for pocket counters, loading percentages, the M7mod wordmark, and the exclude-count badge.

shadows.name: button-lift
shadows.purpose: Generate button at rest; hover deepens to 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.55) with a -1px lift.

shadows.name: tower-drop
shadows.purpose: The support tower image, the only element that floats off the page.

shadows.name: modal-float
shadows.purpose: Exclusion modal over a rgba(8, 9, 12, .82) scrim.

motion.name: card-reveal
motion.value: .34s cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1) (scale .9 to 1.02 overshoot to 1, opacity .35 to 1)
motion.purpose: Pocket landing at the end of its 45ms flicker window in the 45ms x 8 stagger.

motion.name: question-pulse
motion.purpose: The neutral-sleeve ? held during each pocket's mystery window; no rarity color leaks while the card is unknown.

motion.name: ink-flash
motion.value: .55s ease (radial #f5f1e6 at 22% alpha, opacity 0 to 1 to 0)
motion.purpose: One-shot paper flash on the pocket the moment the card lands and the sleeve stamps on.

motion.name: meter-settle
motion.purpose: Elixir meter fill, driven by --avg; settles exactly when the average lands.

motion.name: reveal-stagger
motion.purpose: The signature cascade; each pocket holds a neutral question-mark flicker during its window.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Scale-only adjustments (h1 44 to 34, button 240 to 200 min-width, grid gap 8 to 6, stat value 30 to 26, chips 2-per-row, popover 240 to 216, exclusion grid minmax 74 to 62, modal footer stacks). Structure and 4x2 baseline are unchanged.

texture.name: halftone-ground
texture.purpose: Faint print/cardstock dot grid on the ground; 1.8% alpha, visible only on close inspection.

browserSurfaces.focusRings: 2px solid #f5f1e6 offset 3px on dark surfaces; accent ring on controls

components.name: Generate Button (Primary)
components.description: The single saturated action on the page: accent-filled, Lalezar label, neutral lift shadow; reserved for the generate/confirm moment.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-width: 240px; background: var(--accent, #d32f8f); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #d32f8f); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Lalezar', 'Rubik', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: .02em; padding: 9px 26px 7px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.45); transition: filter .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.08); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.55); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong, #f5f1e6); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .38; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; filter: none; }

components.name: Option Chip
components.description: Checkbox on the cardstock: pocket-interior bed, hairline border; checked state takes the accent border and its soft tint bed.
components.css: .ds-option-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: var(--panel-2, #101216); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2e37); color: var(--text, #cfd2d8); font-family: 'Rubik', 'Cairo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: border-color .15s ease, background .15s ease; } .ds-option-chip:hover { border-color: var(--border-2, #3a3f4a); } .ds-option-chip:has(.ds-option-chip-input:checked) { border-color: var(--accent, #d32f8f); background: var(--accent-soft, rgba(211, 47, 143, .12)); color: var(--text-strong, #f5f1e6); } .ds-option-chip-input { width: 13px; height: 13px; accent-color: var(--accent, #d32f8f); cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Pocket Slot (Revealed, Legendary)
components.description: The signature plate: 2px corners, fixed aspect 1/1.14 so the pocket holds its size while the art is hidden, 3px top sleeve strip in the rarity color (held neutral at the hairline color during the ? flicker), mono counter label pinned bottom-center. The sleeve is a background strip, never a border.
components.css: .ds-pocket { position: relative; width: 88px; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1.14; background: linear-gradient(var(--sleeve, var(--border, #2a2e37)), var(--sleeve, var(--border, #2a2e37))) no-repeat top / 100% 3px, var(--panel-2, #101216); border: 1px solid #23262e; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-pocket-legendary { --sleeve: var(--rarity-legendary, #ffd54a); } .ds-pocket-label { position: absolute; bottom: 3px; left: 0; right: 0; text-align: center; font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--text-faint, #8f98a5); }

components.name: Elixir Meter
components.description: The settling measure: 4px track on #23262e, accent fill anchored right; width is driven by --avg so the fill lands exactly when the average settles.
components.css: .ds-elixir-meter { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 4px; background: #23262e; } .ds-elixir-meter i { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; right: 0; width: min(calc(var(--avg, 0) * 7%), 100%); background: var(--accent, #d32f8f); transition: width .5s cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1); }

components.name: Copy Round Action
components.description: The second real action, accent-filled round button: white icon on elixir pink, neutral hairline, paper-white focus ring.
components.html: <button class="ds-round-action" type="button" title="نسخ التشكيلة"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="15" height="15" fill="currentColor"><path d="M14 3h7v7h-2V6.41l-9.3 9.3-1.4-1.42L17.58 5H14V3zM5 5h6v2H6v12h12v-5h2v6a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H5a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1z"></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-round-action { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #d32f8f); background: var(--accent, #d32f8f); color: #ffffff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: filter .15s ease; } .ds-round-action:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-round-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong, #f5f1e6); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-round-action:disabled { opacity: .35; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: QR Stamp
components.description: The import stamp inside the copy popover: the code sits on a pocket-paper bed under a dashed hairline — the one place paper-white becomes a surface.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: flex; justify-content: center; background: var(--text-strong, #f5f1e6); padding: 6px; border: 1px dashed var(--border-2, #3a3f4a); border-radius: 2px; width: 100%; } .ds-stamp-qr { width: 120px; height: 120px; background: #ffffff; }

narrative.northStar: صفحة جامع البطاقات — The Collector's Binder Page
narrative.overview:
The world is a binder page that gets opened, not a results panel that gets printed. Its physical scene: a Clash Royale player at the tournament table in midnight — dark is forced by the scene, because players open the tool on a phone right before queuing a battle. The ground is a tinted midnight (#14161c) with a cardstock panel language (#191c22 over #101216 pocket interiors), and the 8-card deck reads as a collector's page with fixed-scale plates on one shared baseline, not a SaaS card grid.

Mode is Operate: a task surface, not a marketing page. Compact single-column density (660px centered column), every step of the flow (generate, reveal, tune, import via QR or deep-link) within one or two viewports on mobile, full parity between mobile and desktop (the 550px breakpoint adjusts scale, never structure). The mystery is the product: the staggered reveal is the moment of the experience and is never shortened or skipped. Confirmed rejections: no dark-SaaS-with-one-floating-blue-button default, no colored glows, no framework, no second accent.

The world lends exactly four things to any new surface: the type pairing, the committed-dark palette with its reserved accent, Operate-grade density, and the one signature move (cascade plus settling meter). Layout and standard controls stay standard.
keyCharacteristics: Committed-dark: tinted midnight ground, tonal layering for depth, neutral black shadows only.
One saturated accent (elixir pink #d32f8f) reserved for generate/confirm moments and the settle meter; the only other chroma is the six rarity sleeves and one error red.
Lalezar poster display + Rubik UI workhorse + tabular mono stamps; Arabic letter-spacing stays at 0.
4x2 pockets on one shared baseline, symmetric about the center axis, each wearing a 3px rarity sleeve strip.
Faint 22px halftone dot print texture on the ground — print/cardstock family, 1.8% alpha.

rules.name: The Elixir-Pink Reservation Rule
rules.body: Accent pink appears only in generation/confirmation moments (generate button, copy action, open-link) and on control states (checked chips, active exclude, loading fill, meter fill, caret). If the accent is on a surface that isn't an action or a settled measurement, delete it.

rules.name: The Rarity-Only Chroma Rule
rules.body: The only other saturated colors in the system are the six rarity sleeves and the one error red, and both appear only in data roles (sleeve strip, sleeve label, error state). No new hues; no rarity color drifting into UI chrome.

rules.name: The Zero-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Arabic letter-spacing is 0 — no tracking on any Arabic body or UI text. The only tracked faces are the Latin/mono stamps (wordmark .18em, pocket counters .08em, options label 0) and the .02em poster tracking on the Lalezar generate button.

rules.name: The Shared-Baseline Rule
rules.body: All eight pockets share one row geometry — fixed aspect (1/1.14, set on the slot so it holds size while the art is hidden), one card image scale, one 3px sleeve plane. No pocket may scale, float, or break the grid; symmetry about the center axis is load-bearing.

rules.name: The Neutral-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is neutral black with offset plus blur. No accent glow, no rarity glow, no ambient colored light — the accent's rarity is its restraint.

rules.name: The 2px Pocket Rule
rules.body: Pockets stay angular at 2px corners; the sleeve is a 3px top strip rendered in the background, never a thick border on rounded corners. A pocket with a visible border-width greater than 1px or a large radius is out of the world.

dos: Do keep Arabic letter-spacing at 0 — tracking applies only to Latin/mono stamps (wordmark .18em, counters .08em) and the .02em on the Lalezar generate button.

Do reserve the accent pink for generation/confirmation moments (generate, copy, open-link), control-activation states (checked chips, active exclude, loading/meter fill, caret), and the settle meter — nothing else.
Do keep pockets at 2px angular corners with the rarity sleeve as a 3px top strip; keep all eight pockets on the shared 4x2 baseline, symmetric about the center axis.
Do use neutral black offset+blur shadows only, and keep the 22px 1.8%-alpha halftone dot texture on the ground.
Do use Lalezar exclusively for display/section titles/values, Rubik for all UI text, and the mono stack for every numeral, counter, and stamp.
Do preserve the JS class hooks, the Arabic copy, and the footer verbatim — new screens join the world, they don't rewrite it.
donts: Don't let the accent become decoration: no pink on hairlines, glows, hover washes, backgrounds, or a second accent anywhere.
Don't add colored glows or colored drop-shadows — the world is neutral-shadow only.
Don't round or thicken pockets (no large radii, no border greater than 1px); the sleeve is a strip, never a border.
Don't track Arabic text or introduce a second display face.

Don't drift the layout off the shared baseline, break center-axis symmetry, or let standard controls (checkbox, input, button) grow custom shapes — the world lends type, palette, density, and one signature move; layout and standard controls stay standard.
Don't add a framework or build step; this is a static RTL site.
